Hi all,

just a short note on the Minecraft/esports topic while we are looking at activities and responsibilities for the coming semester.

At the moment there is no school esports programme scheduled for the coming semester, and I am not aware of a classroom Minecraft rollout being planned either.

The earlier pilot and follow-up material are still useful if we want to revisit the idea, but we currently do not have a recurring programme slot or a clearly confirmed internal owner for a larger Minecraft esports initiative.

Some ICT and activities responsibilities may also change during the next planning period, so it is not yet clear who would take ownership if the idea is brought forward again.

I would therefore avoid describing the earlier pilot as an ongoing school programme. Likewise, the previous discussion about external competition should not be treated as a current commitment.

This is not intended as a permanent decision against the idea. If somebody wants to pick it up again in a later planning cycle, we would need to look again at the format, ownership, available time and the school priorities at that point.

I do not know whether there was a specific decision after the earlier pilot that explains why the project did not develop further. I am only recording the current planning position.

Best,
Daniel
